regulator: EMAP (Empresa Maranhense de Administração Portuária) — administers the Ponta da Espera and Cujupe terminals and, under state law 11.909/2023, plans/concedes/regulates intermunicipal waterway passenger transport (took over the waterway attribution from MOB, Agência Estadual de Mobilidade Urbana e Serviços Públicos, which retains mobility-integration/ticketing programs). Vessel and crew certification: Marinha do Brasil — Capitania dos Portos do Maranhão (CP-MA).
annual_basis_note: No continuous official annual passenger series is published openly. The official anchor is the 2017 record year: 1.8M passengers + 371.5k vehicles through Ponta da Espera/Cujupe (Gov. do Maranhão / EMAP). EMAP's Relatório Anual de Administração 2024 (filed with TCE-MA) documents the six-vessel 2024 fleet and should contain recent volumes, but the TCE-MA file link returned empty on retrieval (2026-07-19). Festival-window counts (Carnival ~71.7k/11 days; Holy Week ~50k expected) are official EMAP figures. FX converted at 5.0727 BRL/USD (BCB PTAX 2026-07-15).
gaps: Annual passenger series 2018–2025 for the ferry system — EMAP Relatório Anual 2024 (TCE-MA hosted PDF) could not be downloaded; request directly from EMAP for economics sign-off.

The payload's '190–220k per festival period' figure could NOT be cleanly attributed to Maranhão: an identical '190 mil passageiros e 32 mil veículos' São João figure circulates for Salvador's São Joaquim–Bom Despacho crossing (Bahia), and only social-media posts tie it to the MA system. Excluded from demand_series pending an official MA source.
No official passenger counts for the Praia Grande–Alcântara lancha/catamaran corridor (tourism crossing) — only fares and schedule behavior are documented.
No official MOB/EMAP-published consolidated tariff table found online for all four ferry operators (Henvil's own table used; Internacional Marítima publishes sales points but not a full open table).
No premium ride-hail (Uber Black-class) fare comparable verified for São Luís; guided-tour pricing used as the premium water comparable instead.
